classification.difficultyReason: Students translate depression angles into horizontal distances, identify the perpendicular plan triangle and subtract its angle from a reverse bearing.

content.prompt:
Two boats are observed from a lighthouse $350\text{ m}$ above sea level.
Boat X is on a bearing of $138^\circ\mathrm{T}$ and at an angle of depression of $23^\circ$.
Boat Y is on a bearing of $228^\circ\mathrm{T}$ and at an angle of depression of $16^\circ$.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Calculate the distance between boat X and boat Y, to the nearest metre.

answer.worked:
Let $O$ be the foot of the lighthouse. The angles of elevation from the boats equal the corresponding angles of depression.
$$\begin{aligned}OX&=\frac{350}{\tan23^\circ}\\OY&=\frac{350}{\tan16^\circ}\\\angle XOY&=228^\circ-138^\circ\\&=90^\circ\end{aligned}$$
By Pythagoras’ theorem,
$$\begin{aligned}XY&=\sqrt{OX^2+OY^2}\\&=\sqrt{\left(\frac{350}{\tan23^\circ}\right)^2+\left(\frac{350}{\tan16^\circ}\right)^2}\\&\approx1473\text{ m}.\end{aligned}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: Calculate the bearing of boat Y from boat X, to the nearest degree.

answer.worked:
Let $\theta=\angle OXY$. Using the unrounded horizontal distances from part a,
$$\begin{aligned}\tan\theta&=\frac{OY}{OX}\\\theta&=\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{350/\tan16^\circ}{350/\tan23^\circ}\right)\\&\approx56^\circ.\end{aligned}$$
The bearing of $O$ from X is $138^\circ+180^\circ=318^\circ$. The direction XY lies anticlockwise from XO.
$$\begin{aligned}\text{Bearing of Y from X}&=318^\circ-\theta\\&\approx262^\circ\mathrm{T}.\end{aligned}$$
